headlines.description: Super sub Ferran Torres fired Spain to their second men's World Cup triumph as what may be Lionel Messi's last dance ended in 10-man Argentina falling to a meek 1-0 extratime defeat.
headlines.shortLinkText: Torres scores in ET vs Argentina to win Spain WC
